summary: RotationLab helps farmers compare four-year crop rotations side by side to see when heavy rain falls on uncovered ground, when planting may be possible, and when dry spells overlap sensitive growth stages.
details: The app maps daily NASA POWER rainfall and temperature across 3,143 U.S. counties and equivalents. It combines rainfall with local crop calendars to compare rotations in Iowa and Nebraska, and uses NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 projections to stress-test plans through 2031.
